annotations.title: Find real churches near a place, or one church by id

description: PURPOSE: Find real churches near a place, nearest first, merged live from churches on The Living Bread and an open worldwide directory of about 120,000 churches; or read one directory church's open data record by its id. WHEN TO USE: "a Baptist church in Dallas", "a parish near Manchester", or after another answer returned an lb:church id. WHEN NOT: services or events at a time: find_gatherings. Groups to join or student communities: find_communities. What a tradition is: learn_the_faith (mode heritage). MODES (required parameters in brackets): near [lat and lng, or city] churches within 250 km (denomination filters by one lowercase word such as "baptist" or "catholic"; limit 1 to 20, default 8). by_id [id, or country and slug] one church: pass the whole lb:church:<country>/<slug> as id, or its two parts. OUTPUT: mode, answered_by, and: near gives searched, count, churches [{id, name, where, distance_km, denomination, on_living_bread, url}], find_a_church and gatherings links, plus honest and nearest_we_hold when count is 0; by_id gives id, name, url, denomination, country, website, verified and provenance. BEHAVIOR: read only; reads the live directory and geocodes the city. City level by design: names, city and distance, never street addresses or contacts. No church within 250 km returns count 0 with an honest sentence and the nearest one held, if any. An unknown id returns a not_found error. The search words (never a user id) are logged anonymously. Parameters a mode does not use are ignored and named in ignored_params. Access: no sign-in; shared limit of 300 requests a minute per IP.

city.description: For near: a city, region or country, used when there are no coordinates: "Dallas", "Lagos". Geocoded to its centre.

country.description: For by_id without id: the country slug, e.g. "colombia".

denomination.description: For near: one lowercase tradition word: "baptist", "catholic", "methodist", "pentecostal", "orthodox", "anglican".

id.description: For by_id: the full id, e.g. "lb:church:colombia/iglesia-la-capuchina".

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees, only if the person shared their location; pair with lng. Coordinates win over city.

lng.description: Longitude in decimal degrees, paired with lat.

mode.description: Which kind of answer: near, by_id. Each mode, and the parameters it needs, is explained in the description.

slug.description: For by_id without id: the church slug, e.g. "iglesia-la-capuchina".

name: find_churches

answered_by.description: The implementation that answered (the same tool name the signed-in endpoint lists).

attribution.description: Credit line for the data: The Living Bread (living-bread.org).

content_layers.description: Which fields are Scripture and which are human interpretation or reflection.

evidence.description: Present when Scripture was read: translation, canon, corpus version, attribution, and a SHA-256 per passage.

freshness.description: How current the answer is: kind (scheduled | recently_observed | verified_live | record), retrieved_at, available_now (true only when activity was verified live).

ids.description: Up to 25 ids found in this answer, for follow-up calls.

ignored_params.description: Parameters given that this mode does not use.

license.description: License URL of the returned data (CC BY 4.0 unless stated).

next_actions.description: Up to 4 links the person can open next.

ok.description: Always true on a successful answer (errors come back as isError, never here).

result_state.description: "empty" when nothing matched (count 0, no results); the text then says so plainly.

source_url.description: The first public web page this answer came from or points to.

visibility.description: "public" for shared data, "yours" for the signed-in believer's own data.

title: Find real churches near a place, or one church by id
